introduction: I entered property-management fintech without prior domain experience. The strongest thesis I developed appeared when I stopped centering the rent calendar.
Fyxed treats rent timing and repair funding as separate programs. My thesis concerned where the repair conversation should begin.
fyxed.title: At Fyxed, a repair changed who the product had to ask.

inherited.title: Property manager
inherited.body: The initial product story centered here: help the property manager handle rent timing.

repair.title: A priced repair
repair.body: A priced repair created a decision the timing story did not resolve.

proposal.title: Owner
proposal.body: Would the owner choose to cover the financing cost so the repair could happen now?

unknowns.title: Before the thesis can become product truth
items: The operating path still needs contractual and accounting validation.
The market test is whether owners actually choose this option.

fyxed.boundary: This is a proposed product and GTM thesis. The owner-paid path is still unverified.

futureclinic.title: The role was broad. The public proof is still narrow.
paragraphs: At FutureClinic, I worked across product and implementation on an AI creator workflow.
The product idea was to keep the working state visible across the production process. The final case needs the exact artifact before that idea can carry more weight.
futureclinic.boundary: Founder attribution and usage outcomes stay out until the source pass is complete.

close.statement: I do my best work while the real product question is still taking shape.
